//2: Edit this file to control which folders and notes Claude is allowed to read.
//3: No code changes needed - just update the values below and restart the server.

access.//mode_help: Choose how access is restricted: 'all', 'allowlist', or 'denylist'
access.//mode_all: 'all'        -> every folder and note is accessible (no restrictions)
access.//mode_allow: 'allowlist'  -> ONLY folders/notes listed in 'allowedFolders' / 'allowedNotes' are accessible
access.//mode_deny: 'denylist'   -> every folder/note is accessible EXCEPT those listed in 'blockedFolders' / 'blockedNotes'
access.//allowedFolders_help: Used only when mode = 'allowlist'. Exact folder names as they appear in Notes app.
access.//allowedNotes_help: Used only when mode = 'allowlist'. Exact or partial note titles to allow.
access.//blockedFolders_help: Used only when mode = 'denylist'. Exact folder names to hide from Claude.
access.//blockedNotes_help: Used only when mode = 'denylist'. Exact or partial note titles to hide.

limits.//maxNotesPerListing_help: Safety cap on how many notes can be returned in one 'list_notes' call.
limits.//maxSearchResults_help: Safety cap on how many results 'search_notes' can return at once.
limits.//maxNoteBodyLength_help: Truncate very long note bodies to this many characters (0 = no limit).

behavior.//includeSnippetsInSearch_help: If true, search results include a short preview of matching text, not just titles.
behavior.//snippetLength_help: Length (characters) of the preview snippet shown around the matched keyword.
behavior.//caseSensitiveSearch_help: If true, keyword search distinguishes uppercase/lowercase.
